en: A vintage Italian postal card with printed heading "CARTOLINA POSTALE ITALIANA (CARTE POSTALE D'ITALIE)" and the Savoy coat of arms in the center. In the upper-right corner is a reddish-brown Italian postage stamp depicting a man in profile, denominated 10 centesimi, with circular cancellation marks reading "VERONA" and date details. There is another circular blue-green postmark on the left. The front is filled with handwritten address text in cursive, partly in Russian, indicating it was sent to Saint Petersburg, Russia.
